prompt:
Create ONE clean transparent PNG animation spritesheet for Tinh Linh Nang Am Stage 1.
Use the attached front-facing MASTER render as the strict identity source.

Character identity, preserve strictly in every frame:
cute chibi warm forest sunlight deer spirit pet, front-facing, cream and soft green fluffy body, large warm amber eyes, tiny orange nose and cute mouth, soft peach blush cheeks, small leaf-antler sprouts on the head, big friendly ears with warm inner color, leafy side tufts and tail-like leaf accents, small paws, glowing heart-shaped chest gem, cozy plant sunlight palette. Preserve leaf antlers, big ears, cream-green body, amber eyes, glowing heart chest mark, leafy accents, tiny paws, warm cozy deer-spirit identity. Do not turn it into the sprout baby form, do not remove antlers, do not add crescent moon crest, bird beak, accessories, text, or background.

CRITICAL GRID REQUIREMENT:
- The final image must be exactly one spritesheet with 6 horizontal rows and 8 vertical columns.
- Total visible character frames: exactly 48.
- There must be 8 frames in every row, no missing cells, no extra rows, no extra columns.
- Use a 4:3 wide canvas suitable for an 8 columns x 6 rows grid.
- Each cell is a square animation frame.
- Place exactly one full character pose centered inside each cell.
- Make the character smaller than the cell: use only about 58 to 62 percent of each cell height.
- Leave large transparent safe padding around every pose, especially above ears/crest/antlers and below feet/tail.
- Do not let any pose touch or cross cell boundaries.
- Do not crop the character, ears, crest, antlers, wings, leaves, tail, feet, or shadow.
- Keep same scale, same ground line, same body registration across all frames.
- No text labels, no row names, no frame numbers, no contact sheet labels, no grid lines, no UI frames.
- Transparent background only, real alpha transparency. No checkerboard baked into the image, no white background.

Global production rules:
Cute mobile virtual pet animation, cozy fantasy spirit pet, soft chibi game asset, hand-painted polished mobile-game look, clean readable silhouette, readable at 128px. Keep mostly front-facing except small head/eye direction changes for hungry. Registration stability is more important than dramatic motion. Smooth source-frame motion, no duplicated hold frames. No external effects, no stars, no particles, no props, no food objects, no accessories. Do not redesign the character or change species.

Spritesheet row plan, left to right:
ROW 1 Idle, 8 frames: neutral eyes open; soft blink; eyes open calm; tiny natural appendage motion; soft breath down; soft breath up; settles; loop-compatible neutral.
ROW 2 Happy, 8 frames: gentle smile; smile grows; eyes brighter/livelier by expression only; tiny body/arms/wing lift; appendages perk cheerfully; soft follow-through; relaxed lively pose; loop-compatible happy.
ROW 3 Sad, 8 frames: slightly sad eyes; small sad mouth and lowered eyelids; appendages droop slightly; body sinks gently; appendages fold closer; soft sad breath; final sad resting pose; loop-compatible sad hold. No tears, rain, injury, sickness, dirt, scary mood, or symbols.
ROW 4 Sleep, 8 frames: tired neutral eyes open; eyelids lower; head dips gently; body sinks slightly; appendages relax inward; eyes nearly closed; fully closed calm sleeping pose; loop-compatible sleep hold. No Z symbols or bubbles.
ROW 5 Excited, 8 frames: excited neutral bright eyes; anticipation squash; cheerful mouth; tiny jump peak rises slightly; appendages bounce upward; soft landing squash; recovered excited pose; loop-compatible excited hold. Keep jump tiny and fully inside canvas.
ROW 6 Hungry, 8 frames: hungry neutral slightly tired eyes; small mouth opens; tiny cute drool appears; head and eyes look upper-left around 11 o'clock; return toward center with small cute drool; tiny hungry breath; head and eyes look lower-right around 5 o'clock; loop-compatible hungry pose. Do not add food, drool must be small and adorable.

Style: same as master render, cute cozy mobile pet source frames, soft hand-painted chibi fantasy, gentle shadows and highlights, no harsh neon, no realism, no pixel art, no heavy black outlines.
